metadata.description: Learn how to build real-world AI applications with TensorFlow! In this hands-on course, you’ll train neural networks for computer vision, apply techniques like data augmentation, dropout, and transfer learning, and build natural language processing systems using RNNs, GRUs, and LSTMs. Through project-based learning, you’ll gain practical experience creating image classifiers, object detectors, and text generators—preparing you with the skills to design and deploy powerful AI solutions.
metadata.tools: Jupyter Notebooks, Google Colab, ChatGPT, Github Copilot

clos.clo_details: Understand the basics of TensorFlow and application of TensorFlow framework in Machine Learning, Deep Learning.
Understand how to build a basic neural network in TensorFlow and train a neural network for a computer vision application.
Understan the convolutional Neural Networks in TensorFlow, include the strategies to prevent overfitting, including augmentation and dropout
Undesrstand the transfer learning and how learned features can be extracted from models
Understand basic concepts of sentiment in text, word Embeddings, sequence model and literature
Implementing natural language processing systems using TensorFlow
Understand the sequences, time series and prediction problems in TensorFlow
Understand how to apply RNNs, GRUs, and LSTMs as you train them using text repositories
Understand how to apply AI tools to complete a mini project
Implement a AI project includes steps: data collection, data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, model development, model evaluation, and reporting
